standard_prerequisites: Divisors, Definition divisors-definition-strict-transform: the strict transform of a closed subscheme under a blowup
Divisors, Lemma divisors-lemma-blowing-up-projective: a blowup morphism is projective

Chow Homology, Lemma chow-lemma-proper-pushforward-rational-equivalence and Lemma chow-lemma-factors: the degree of a line bundle on a proper scheme over a field is well defined on one-cycles modulo rational equivalence

The conics C given by x y equals z squared and w equals zero, and D given by x y equals w squared and z equals zero, in projective three-space over the complex numbers are smooth, meet transversally in the two reduced points P equals the point with coordinates one zero zero zero and Q equals the point with coordinates zero one zero zero, and each is isomorphic to the projective line
core_obligations: On Y minus Q first blow up the curve C and then blow up the strict transform of D; on Y minus P first blow up D and then blow up the strict transform of C; over Y minus P minus Q the two constructions are canonically isomorphic and glue to a smooth proper threefold V-Y over the complex numbers
The morphism f from V-Y to Y is proper and Zariski-locally projective, since it is a blowup over each of the two open pieces

Let L and M be the inverse images of a complex point of C minus P minus Q and of a complex point of D minus P minus Q; both are projective lines, and the inverse image E of C union D is proper over C union D with projective line fibers away from P and Q

Near P the inverse image of P is a union of two lines L-zero and M-zero, and there are rational equivalences of cycles L equals L-zero plus M-zero and M equals M-zero on E; near Q the reversed order of blowups gives lines L-zero-prime and M-zero-prime with L equal to L-zero-prime and M equal to L-zero-prime plus M-zero-prime
Combining the equivalences gives L-zero plus M-zero-prime rationally equivalent to zero on E, hence on V-Y

If V-Y were projective over the complex numbers it would carry an ample line bundle of positive degree on every curve; in particular positive degree on L-zero plus M-zero-prime, contradicting well-definedness of the degree of a line bundle on one-cycles modulo rational equivalence on a proper scheme over a field; hence V-Y is not projective over the complex numbers and f is not projective
proof_roadmap: Glue the two blowup towers over the common open piece
Read off the rational equivalences among the four exceptional lines over the two intersection points
Derive the rationally trivial cycle and contradict ampleness via well-defined degree
